decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game through a mix of card draw, removal, and counter spells. It aims to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage with Stock Up and Tablet of Discovery, while also disrupting their strategy with removal like Firebending Lesson and Shoot the Sheriff. By controlling the board and hand with spells like Inevitable Defeat and Duress, the deck can maintain the upper hand and ultimately secure victory through powerful finishers like Jeskai Revelation and Deadly Cover-Up.

The primary focus of this Mono Green Aggro deck is to quickly build up a wide board presence using efficient creatures like Ba Sing Se, Badgermole Cub, and Llanowar Elves, while utilizing cards like Demolition Field and Mightform Harmonizer to pump up their power and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Escape Tunnel and Fabled Passage to ensure consistent mana production and smooth out the deck's draws. This deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain that pressure throughout the game to secure a fast victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through manipulation of the opponent's resources and board state. By using cards like Duress, Deadly Cover-Up, and Strategic Betrayal, the player aims to disrupt their opponent's strategy and protect their own win conditions. The inclusion of cards like Firdoch Core and Bitter Triumph allows for card advantage and resource management. The deck utilizes a mix of creatures and spells to maintain board presence and outvalue the opponent. The overall strategy revolves around efficiently controlling the game until the player can secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells, utilizing cards like Stormchaser's Talent, Burst Lightning, and Slickshot Show-Off to deal damage quickly. The deck also includes bounce spells like Boomerang Basics and Flow State to disrupt the opponent's board state and keep up the pressure. Additionally, there are cards like Spell Pierce for early disruption and Prismari Charm for versatility. The mana base is optimized with both Islands and dual lands like Steam Vents and Spirebluff Canal to ensure smooth mana production for casting spells efficiently.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using low-cost creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Slickshot Show-Off, supported by efficient removal spells like Burst Lightning and Boomerang Basics. The deck aims to maintain a fast tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Hydro-Man, Fluid Felon and Spell Pierce. By utilizing card draw spells such as Opt and Sleight of Hand, the deck can consistently find its threats and maintain pressure throughout the game while controlling the board with cards like Shore Up and Stormchaser's Talent.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence and deal direct damage to the opponent using cheap spells and creatures. The deck focuses on tempo play and controlling the board with cards like Boomerang Basics and Eddymurk Crab, while also pushing damage through with cards like Burst Lightning and Slickshot Show-Off. The inclusion of cards like Flow State and Stormchaser's Talent helps to pump up creatures and finish off opponents quickly. Overall, this deck aims to win the game through efficient, aggressive gameplay.

This deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence with aggressive creatures and efficient mana ramp. Key cards like Earthbender Ascension and Esper Origins help to power up the deck's creatures, while cards like Escape Tunnel and Fabled Passage provide additional mana fixing and card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early creatures like Badgermole Cub and Sazh's Chocobo, while also having options for late-game power with cards like Mightform Harmonizer and Surrak, Elusive Hunter. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around putting pressure on the opponent and maintaining a solid mana base.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By efficiently utilizing cards such as Erode, Case of the Uneaten Feast, and Hinterland Sanctifier to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while deploying strong creatures like Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Haliya, Guided by Light, the deck aims to maintain board control and keep up pressure. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to finish the game swiftly before the opponent has a chance to recover.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with low-cost creatures and ramp spells to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. The creatures in the deck are efficient and can quickly grow in size with the help of support cards. The deck also includes some removal spells and protection for key creatures to maintain aggression. The goal is to establish a threatening board state quickly and put pressure on the opponent to make quick decisions to respond.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost creatures and spells to put pressure on the opponent. Utilizing cards like Burst Lightning, Slickshot Show-Off, and Spell Pierce for removal and disruption, while also using cards like Flow State and Riverpyre Verge to maintain card advantage and tempo. The deck aims to outpace the opponent with fast, aggressive plays and efficient card draw, utilizing a mix of direct damage, creature buffing, and disruptive spells to control the board and ensure victory through overwhelming aggression.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively eliminating opponents with a mix of powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Case of the Uneaten Feast and Lunar Convocation for additional resources, as well as Erode and Seam Rip for targeted removal, the deck aims to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. Cards like Haliya, Guided by Light and Moseo, Vein's New Dean provide additional utility and support, while Aunt May and Zoraline, Cosmos Caller offer unique win conditions. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and resource manipulation.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of card draw and removal spells. It includes various lands that can produce multiple colors of mana to support the spells in the deck. It also incorporates cards that can counter opponent's spells and wipe out the board if necessary. The deck aims to outlast the opponent by managing resources effectively and disrupting their game plan while setting up its win condition through powerful card draw and removal spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies, utilizing a combination of creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and maintain that pressure throughout, forcing them to constantly react to threats. With a mix of efficient creatures and powerful spells, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and proactive, aiming to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a victory.

The main idea of this Jeskai Control deck is to utilize a combination of card draw and removal spells to control the board and out-value your opponent. By playing efficient removal like Combustion Technique and Firebending Lesson, alongside card draw spells like Accumulate Wisdom and Gran-Gran, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and answer threats as they arise. Additionally, utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Thor, God of Thunder and powerful artifacts like Tablet of Discovery provides additional value and versatility in both controlling the game and advancing your own win conditions.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with a combination of cheap and efficient creatures like Greasewrench Goblin and Emberheart Challenger, while also using direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Shock to control the board and finish off the opponent. The deck also features powerful flying threats like Nova Hellkite and Zhao, the Moon Slayer to provide additional pressure. With a strong emphasis on speed and aggression, this Red Deck Wins archetype aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize and turn the game in their favor.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Colorstorm Stallion and Eddymurk Crab, backed up by powerful spells like Burst Lightning and Opt. The deck aims to control the board through bounce effects like Boomerang Basics and tempo plays with Sleight of Hand, while continuously applying pressure with creatures like Slickshot Show-Off and utilizing Stormchaser's Talent to close out the game quickly. The deck focuses on a fast-paced, proactive strategy to outpace the opponent and secure victories.
